TIAMATBEAST-CARAPACE.title: Larval Carapace
TIAMATBEAST-SPAWN_LAHMU.title: Spawn
TIAMATBEAST-EYE_OF_THE_BLUE_STAR.title: Eye of the Blue Star
TIAMATBEAST-EYE_OF_THE_BLUE_STAR.descrip: #Gain !NpCharge! NP Charge. Apply !Weak! Weak to the most-cursed enemy.
TIAMATBEAST-BLACK_MUD.title: Black Mud
TIAMATBEAST-RISING_TIDE.title: Rising Tide
TIAMATBEAST-SUCKLE.title: Suckle
TIAMATBEAST-SUCKLE.description: #Gain !Nurture! Nurture. If you have 3 or more Laḫmu, draw 1 card.
TIAMATBEAST-MITOSIS.title: Mitosis
TIAMATBEAST-MITOSIS.description: #Devour 1 Laḫmu: deal !D! damage, plus !PerNurture! for each Nurture. Then spawn 1 Laḫmu.
TIAMATBEAST-BLACK_DELUGE.title: Black Deluge
TIAMATBEAST-BLACK_DELUGE.description: #Apply !Curse! Curse to ALL enemies. Gain !Nurture! Nurture for each enemy that was ALREADY cursed.
TIAMATBEAST-EYE_OF_THE_RED_STAR.title: Eye of the Red Star
TIAMATBEAST-EYE_OF_THE_RED_STAR.descript: #Apply !Curse! Curse to an enemy and reduce its Strength by !Strength!. If it already had !Threshold! or more Curse, apply !Overflow! more Curse.
TIAMATBEAST-SEA_OF_THE_AZURE_STAR.title: Sea of the Azure Star
TIAMATBEAST-SEA_OF_THE_AZURE_STAR.descri: #Heal !H! HP and gain !NpCharge! NP Charge. In co-op, your allies also heal and charge.
TIAMATBEAST-CORE_OF_THE_GODDESS.title: Core of the Goddess
TIAMATBEAST-CORE_OF_THE_GODDESS.descript: #Gain Debuff Resistance (negate the next !Artifact!). At the start of your turns, gain !NpPerTurn! NP Charge.
TIAMATBEAST-TIDAL_SEAL.title: Tidal Seal
TIAMATBEAST-TIDAL_SEAL.description: #Apply !Seal! Skill Seal and !Curse! Curse to an enemy.
TIAMATBEAST-CALL_OF_THE_SEA.title: Call of the Sea of Life
TIAMATBEAST-STAGNANT_TIDE.title: Stagnant Tide
TIAMATBEAST-STAGNANT_TIDE.description: #Apply !Curse! Curse to an enemy. Until your next turn, your Curses do not decay after dealing damage.
TIAMATBEAST-OVERTIDE.title: Overtide
TIAMATBEAST-OVERTIDE.description: #Consume up to !Curse! Curse from the most-cursed enemy to gain !NpCharge! NP Charge and !Nurture! Nurture.
TIAMATBEAST-ELEVEN_BEL_LAHMU.title: Eleven Bel Laḫmu
TIAMATBEAST-ELEVEN_BEL_LAHMU.description: #Spawn up to !Lahmu! Laḫmu. Gain !NurturePerSpawn! Nurture for each slot you filled.
TIAMATBEAST-BROKEN_HORN.title: Broken Horn
TIAMATBEAST-BROKEN_HORN.description: #Devour ALL your Laḫmu. For each one devoured, deal !PerHorn! damage to ALL enemies, increased by !PerNurture! per Nurture. Gain !NpPerLahmu! NP Charge per Laḫmu.
TIAMATBEAST-LARVAL_SURGE.title: Larval Surge
TIAMATBEAST-LARVAL_SURGE.description: #Gain !NpCharge! NP Charge. If this crosses the 100 threshold, gain Overcharge Blessing (+1 turn to your next Beast window).
TIAMATBEAST-CHAOS_TIDE_DELUGE.title: Chaos Tide: Deluge
TIAMATBEAST-SPAWN_LAHMU_BEAST.title: Spawn Laḫmu
TIAMATBEAST-SPAWN_LAHMU_BEAST.descriptio: #Spawn !Lahmu! Laḫmu. If your swarm is already full, gain !Nurture! Nurture instead. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-FEED_LAHMU_BEAST.title: Suckle Laḫmu
TIAMATBEAST-FEED_LAHMU_BEAST.description: #Gain !Nurture! Nurture. If you have 4 or more Laḫmu, draw 1 card. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-DEVOUR_THE_CHILDREN.title: Devour the Children
TIAMATBEAST-DEVOUR_THE_CHILDREN.descript: #Devour up to !Devour! Laḫmu: deal !D! damage each, plus !PerNurture! per Nurture, plus a third of the target's Curse. Then spawn 1 Laḫmu. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-LAHMU_TIDE.title: Tide of Laḫmu
TIAMATBEAST-LAHMU_TIDE.description: #Spawn up to !Lahmu! Laḫmu. Gain !NurturePerLahmu! Nurture for each Laḫmu you already had in play. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-BROKEN_HORN_BEAST.title: Broken Horn
TIAMATBEAST-BROKEN_HORN_BEAST.descriptio: #Devour ALL your Laḫmu. For each one devoured, deal !PerHorn! damage to ALL enemies, increased by !PerNurture! per Nurture. Gain !NpPerLahmu! NP Charge per Laḫmu. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-PLUMA_DE_LA_BESTIA.title: Plume of the Beast
TIAMATBEAST-PLUMA_DE_LA_BESTIA.descripti: #Playable at !ChargeCost! NP Charge. Consume ALL NP Charge and cleanse your debuffs, then deal damage to ALL enemies equal to Laḫmu × Nurture × !PerNurture! plus the most-cursed enemy's Curse × !PerCurse! (+!PerTen! per 10 NP over !ChargeCost!). Closes the Beast window. Exhaust.
TIAMATBEAST-NAMMU_DURANKI.title: Nammu Dur-an-ki
TIAMATBEAST-NAMMU_DURANKI.description: #Playable at !ChargeCost! NP Charge. Consume ALL NP Charge to open the Beast window for 1-3 turns (longer the more you banked). Cleanse your debuffs, deal !BaseDamage! damage (+1 per 10 NP consumed) to ALL enemies and apply !Seal! Skill Seal. Become the Beast and manifest the Beast deck. Gain 1 energy and draw 2. Retain, Exhaust.
